description: Daily settlement report for one China commodity futures product on one trading day: every contract's open, high, low, close, settlement, prior settlement, volume (lots), open interest and turnover, plus a main contract (highest open interest). Covers SHFE (rebar rb, gold au, silver ag, copper cu...), INE (crude sc, rubber nr...), ZCE (cotton CF, sugar SR, apples AP...) and GFEX (lithium carbonate lc, industrial silicon si...). A listed-but-dormant product (e.g. ZCE wheat WH) returns status "no_listed_activity" with an explanation, not an empty list. DCE (Dalian) is not available. Prices in CNY. Defaults to the latest published trading day.

date.description: Trading day, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD. Omit for the latest published day. Weekends and holidays have no file.

exchange.description: Optional. Inferred from the product code when omitted.

product.description: Exchange product code, case-insensitive: "rb" rebar, "au" gold, "ag" silver, "CF" cotton, "WH" wheat, "lc" lithium carbonate

name: cn_futures_daily
title: Cn Futures Daily
